label: Charcoal Drawing
description: Monochrome charcoal drawing on a toned ground, with velvet blacks, blended mid-tones and lifted highlights; suited to dramatic and intimate scenes alike.
rendering: A finished charcoal drawing of the work's world: broad tonal masses laid in with the side of the stick and blended, forms turned with soft gradations, darks pushed to deep velvet black and lights lifted out with an eraser.
palette: Charcoal black through warm and cool greys to lifted highlights; no color.
lighting: Strong directional light carved out of shadow; luminous highlights emerging from a mid-tone ground.
materials: Granular charcoal texture, smudged and blended passages and crisp accents within the depicted scene; the toned ground is worked over everywhere and reads only as a value inside the picture.
composition: Bold, cinematic massing with one clear focal figure or event; tone carried out to all four edges and corners.
negatives: The drawing fills the whole image: no bare or white paper margin, vignette, border line, tape, mount or frame, and no signature, initials, caption or date. Avoid color, photorealism, hard cartoon outlines and sketchbook presentation.
